# IMPERIA COLD WAR - European Communities 1970 (start, clock, members, calendar, presidency, Commission, Parliament, support).
# Generated by Claude outputs/COLDWAR_EC_generator/build.py - do not edit by hand.

# Any scope. Calendar from the start epoch (1 Jan 1970, 365-day years): temp cwec_t_y (years since 1970), cwec_t_doy (0 = 1 Jan), cwec_t_ystart (num_days of this 1 January).
COLDWAR_EC_calendar_now = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_d = global.num_days }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwec_t_d = global.cwec_epoch }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwec_t_d min = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_doy = cwec_t_d }
	modulo_temp_variable = { var = cwec_t_doy value = 365 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_y = cwec_t_d }
	subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwec_t_y = cwec_t_doy }
	divide_temp_variable = { cwec_t_y = 365 }
	round_temp_variable = cwec_t_y
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_ystart = cwec_t_y }
	multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_ystart = 365 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_ystart = global.cwec_epoch }
}

# Any scope. temp cwec_t_next = num_days of the next 1 January (always in the future).
COLDWAR_EC_next_jan1 = {
	COLDWAR_EC_calendar_now = yes
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_next = cwec_t_ystart }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_next = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwec_t_doy < 0 } } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_next = 365 }
	}
}

# Any scope. temp cwec_t_next = num_days of the next 1 January or 1 July.
COLDWAR_EC_next_half_year = {
	COLDWAR_EC_calendar_now = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_doy < 181 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_next = cwec_t_ystart }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_next = 181 }
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_next = cwec_t_ystart }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_next = 365 }
	}
}

# Any scope. temp cwec_t_next = 7 June at least 365 days from today (first direct election).
COLDWAR_EC_next_june_election = {
	COLDWAR_EC_calendar_now = yes
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_next = cwec_t_ystart }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_next = 157 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_min = global.num_days }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_min = 365 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_next < cwec_t_min } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_next = 365 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_next < cwec_t_min } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_next = 365 }
	}
}

# Country scope. Weight, seats, presidency rank and ratification period.
COLDWAR_EC_set_country_data = {
	# Council weight (CVCE 1973 scale), otherwise by population
	if = {
		limit = { original_tag = FRA }
		set_variable = { cwec_weight = 10 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = GER }
		set_variable = { cwec_weight = 10 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = ITA }
		set_variable = { cwec_weight = 10 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = ENG }
		set_variable = { cwec_weight = 10 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = SPR }
		set_variable = { cwec_weight = 8 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = BEL }
		set_variable = { cwec_weight = 5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = HOL }
		set_variable = { cwec_weight = 5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = GRE }
		set_variable = { cwec_weight = 5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = POR }
		set_variable = { cwec_weight = 5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = AUS }
		set_variable = { cwec_weight = 4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = SWE }
		set_variable = { cwec_weight = 4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = DEN }
		set_variable = { cwec_weight = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = IRE }
		set_variable = { cwec_weight = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = FIN }
		set_variable = { cwec_weight = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = NRY }
		set_variable = { cwec_weight = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = LUX }
		set_variable = { cwec_weight = 2 }
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { population_total_m < 50 } } }
			set_variable = { cwec_weight = 10 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { population_total_m < 25 } } }
			set_variable = { cwec_weight = 8 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { population_total_m < 12 } } }
			set_variable = { cwec_weight = 5 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { population_total_m < 7 } } }
			set_variable = { cwec_weight = 4 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { population_total_m < 3 } } }
			set_variable = { cwec_weight = 3 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { cwec_weight = 2 }
		}
	}
	# Parliament seats: appointed delegations until the first direct election
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_ep_elected }
		if = {
			limit = { original_tag = FRA }
			set_variable = { cwec_seats = 81 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { original_tag = GER }
			set_variable = { cwec_seats = 81 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { original_tag = ITA }
			set_variable = { cwec_seats = 81 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { original_tag = ENG }
			set_variable = { cwec_seats = 81 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { original_tag = HOL }
			set_variable = { cwec_seats = 25 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { original_tag = BEL }
			set_variable = { cwec_seats = 24 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { original_tag = DEN }
			set_variable = { cwec_seats = 16 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { original_tag = IRE }
			set_variable = { cwec_seats = 15 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { original_tag = LUX }
			set_variable = { cwec_seats = 6 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { original_tag = GRE }
			set_variable = { cwec_seats = 24 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { original_tag = SPR }
			set_variable = { cwec_seats = 60 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { original_tag = POR }
			set_variable = { cwec_seats = 24 }
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { population_total_m < 50 } } }
				set_variable = { cwec_seats = 81 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { population_total_m < 35 } } }
				set_variable = { cwec_seats = 60 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { population_total_m < 12 } } }
				set_variable = { cwec_seats = 25 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { population_total_m < 8 } } }
				set_variable = { cwec_seats = 24 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { population_total_m < 5 } } }
				set_variable = { cwec_seats = 16 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { population_total_m < 3 } } }
				set_variable = { cwec_seats = 15 }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { cwec_seats = 6 }
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { original_tag = FRA }
			set_variable = { cwec_seats = 36 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { original_tag = GER }
			set_variable = { cwec_seats = 36 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { original_tag = ITA }
			set_variable = { cwec_seats = 36 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { original_tag = ENG }
			set_variable = { cwec_seats = 36 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { original_tag = BEL }
			set_variable = { cwec_seats = 14 }
		}
		else_if = {

			set_variable = { cwec_seats = 14 }

		else_if = {

		else_if = {

		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { original_tag = IRE }
			set_variable = { cwec_seats = 10 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { original_tag = NRY }
			set_variable = { cwec_seats = 10 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { original_tag = GRE }
			set_variable = { cwec_seats = 24 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { original_tag = SPR }
			set_variable = { cwec_seats = 60 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { original_tag = POR }
			set_variable = { cwec_seats = 24 }
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { population_total_m < 50 } } }
				set_variable = { cwec_seats = 36 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { population_total_m < 25 } } }
				set_variable = { cwec_seats = 24 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { population_total_m < 12 } } }
				set_variable = { cwec_seats = 14 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { population_total_m < 7 } } }
				set_variable = { cwec_seats = 10 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { population_total_m < 3 } } }
				set_variable = { cwec_seats = 6 }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { cwec_seats = 6 }
			}
		}
	}
	# Presidency order (country names in their own languages)
	if = {
		limit = { original_tag = BEL }
		set_variable = { cwec_rank = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = DEN }
		set_variable = { cwec_rank = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = GER }
		set_variable = { cwec_rank = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = GRE }
		set_variable = { cwec_rank = 4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = SPR }
		set_variable = { cwec_rank = 5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = FRA }
		set_variable = { cwec_rank = 6 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = IRE }
		set_variable = { cwec_rank = 7 }
	}
	else_if = {

		set_variable = { cwec_rank = 13 }
	}
	else_if = {

		set_variable = { cwec_rank = 14 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = AUS }
		set_variable = { cwec_rank = 15 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = POR }
		set_variable = { cwec_rank = 16 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = SWI }
		set_variable = { cwec_rank = 17 }
	}

	else_if = {

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { original_tag = ENG }
		set_variable = { cwec_rank = 21 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { cwec_rank = THIS.id }
		add_to_variable = { cwec_rank = 100 }
	}
	# AI ratification period
	if = {
		limit = { original_tag = LUX }
		set_variable = { cwec_ratdays = 60 }
	}
	else_if = {

# Country scope. Starting support for Europe (design 12) and the watch list for the monthly drift.
COLDWAR_EC_init_support = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = cwec_support_base } }
		if = {
			limit = { original_tag = LUX }
			set_variable = { cwec_support_base = 80 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { original_tag = BEL }
			set_variable = { cwec_support_base = 75 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { original_tag = HOL }
			set_variable = { cwec_support_base = 75 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { original_tag = ITA }
			set_variable = { cwec_support_base = 75 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { original_tag = IRE }
			set_variable = { cwec_support_base = 75 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { original_tag = GER }
			set_variable = { cwec_support_base = 70 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { original_tag = FRA }
			set_variable = { cwec_support_base = 60 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { original_tag = DEN }
			set_variable = { cwec_support_base = 62 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { original_tag = NRY }
			set_variable = { cwec_support_base = 52 }

			set_variable = { cwec_support_base = 50 }
		}
		else_if = {

			set_variable = { cwec_support_base = 50 }
		}
		else_if = {

		else_if = {

		else_if = {
			limit = { original_tag = ICE }
			set_variable = { cwec_support_base = 40 }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { cwec_support_base = 30 }
		}
		set_variable = { cwec_support = cwec_support_base }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.cwec_watch value = THIS } } }
		add_to_array = { global.cwec_watch = THIS }
	}
}

# Country scope. The membership spirit (without the political power malus after A Union of States).
COLDWAR_EC_add_member_idea = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_done_A10 }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_EC_member } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_EC_member }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_EC_member_states } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_EC_member_states }
	}
	else = {
		if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_EC_member_states } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_EC_member_states }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_EC_member } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_EC_member }
	}
}

# Country scope. Full membership (start members and every accession).
COLDWAR_EC_join_member = {
	log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: COLDWAR_EC_join_member ([THIS.GetName])"
	set_variable = { cwec_status = 5 }
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_frozen
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_EC_associate } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_EC_associate }
	COLDWAR_EC_add_member_idea = yes
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.cwec_members value = THIS } } }
		add_to_array = { global.cwec_members = THIS }
	}
	COLDWAR_EC_init_support = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_set_country_data = yes
	set_variable = { cwec_member_since = global.num_days }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_EC_community } } }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_EC_community }
	}
	# passive members take part in every open voluntary part (players choose themselves)
	if = {
		limit = { is_ai = yes }
		COLDWAR_EC_ai_join_parts = yes
	}
	COLDWAR_EC_refresh_country = yes
}

# Country scope. Leaves the Communities (player decision or loss of the country). Rejoin after three years.
COLDWAR_EC_leave_member = {
	log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: COLDWAR_EC_leave_member ([THIS.GetName])"
	set_variable = { cwec_status = 0 }
	remove_from_array = { global.cwec_members = THIS }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_EC_member } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_EC_member }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_EC_member_states } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_EC_member_states }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_EC_presidency } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_EC_presidency }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_EC_commission_president } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_EC_commission_president }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_EC_transition } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_EC_transition }
	if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_EC_community } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_EC_community } }
	if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_EC_participation } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_EC_participation } }
	if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_EC_shared_aid } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_EC_shared_aid } }
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_schengen
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_snake
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_ems
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_emu
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_werner3
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_charter
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_airbus
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_ariane
	clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_transition
	set_variable = { cwec_wk_pay = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwec_wk_recv = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwec_net = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwec_aidcap = 0 }
	set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_EC_rejoin_cooldown days = 1095 value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_pres = THIS.id } }
		COLDWAR_EC_rotate_presidency = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_com = THIS.id } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_com = 0 }
	}
	# open accounts: a borrower repays the rest of its loan at once (to the members by GDP share), programmes it requested end, its nominee is withdrawn
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_l1_target = THIS.id } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_rest = global.cwec_l1_end }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwec_t_rest = global.num_days }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwec_t_rest min = 0 }
		divide_temp_variable = { cwec_t_rest = 7 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_rest = global.cwec_l1_weekly }
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = cwec_t_rest }
		multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_lg = 0 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwec_members
			if = { limit = { exists = yes } add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_lg = gdp_total } }
		}
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwec_t_lg min = 0.001 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwec_members
			if = { limit = { exists = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = gdp_total }
				divide_temp_variable = { treasury_change = cwec_t_lg }
				multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = cwec_t_rest }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
			}
		}
		set_variable = { global.cwec_l1_target = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_l1_weekly = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_l2_target = THIS.id } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_rest = global.cwec_l2_end }
		subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwec_t_rest = global.num_days }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwec_t_rest min = 0 }
		divide_temp_variable = { cwec_t_rest = 7 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwec_t_rest = global.cwec_l2_weekly }
		set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = cwec_t_rest }
		multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
		modify_treasury_effect = yes
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_lg = 0 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwec_members
			if = { limit = { exists = yes } add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_lg = gdp_total } }
		}
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwec_t_lg min = 0.001 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwec_members
			if = { limit = { exists = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = gdp_total }
				divide_temp_variable = { treasury_change = cwec_t_lg }
				multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = cwec_t_rest }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
			}
		}
		set_variable = { global.cwec_l2_target = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_l2_weekly = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h1_target > 0 }
			check_variable = { global.cwec_h1_by = THIS.id } }
		COLDWAR_EC_h1_end = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h2_target > 0 }
			check_variable = { global.cwec_h2_by = THIS.id } }
		COLDWAR_EC_h2_end = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h3_target > 0 }
			check_variable = { global.cwec_h3_by = THIS.id } }
		COLDWAR_EC_h3_end = yes
	}
	remove_from_array = { global.cwec_nominees = THIS }
	force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized }
		mdcw_cw_recalculate_country = yes
	}
	COLDWAR_EC_recount = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_budget_recompute = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_update_shared_capacity = yes
}

# Country scope. Association agreement in force.
COLDWAR_EC_become_associate = {
	set_variable = { cwec_status = 1 }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_EC_associate } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_EC_associate }
	COLDWAR_EC_init_support = yes
	# partners are refreshed with the external Community modifier
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.cwec_ext value = THIS } } }
		add_to_array = { global.cwec_ext = THIS }
	}
	COLDWAR_EC_refresh_external_country = yes
}

# Country scope. Passive members take part in every open voluntary part.
COLDWAR_EC_ai_join_parts = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_open_schengen
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_schengen } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_schengen
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_open_snake
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_snake } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_snake
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_open_ems
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_ems } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_ems
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_open_emu
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_emu }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_optout } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_emu
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_open_werner3
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_werner3 } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_werner3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_open_charter
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_charter }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_optout } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_charter
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_open_airbus
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_airbus } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_airbus
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_open_ariane
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_ariane } }
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_ariane
	}
}

# Any scope. Counts members, Council weights, seats, seated players, thresholds and the emblem.
COLDWAR_EC_recount = {
	set_variable = { global.cwec_n_members = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_w_total = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_seats_total = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_n_players = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_n_passive = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_w_players = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_seats_players = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		add_to_variable = { global.cwec_n_members = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwec_w_total = cwec_weight }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwec_seats_total = cwec_seats }
		if = {
			limit = { is_ai = no }
			add_to_variable = { global.cwec_n_players = 1 }
			add_to_variable = { global.cwec_w_players = cwec_weight }
			add_to_variable = { global.cwec_seats_players = cwec_seats }
			set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_EC_player_seen days = 365 value = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			add_to_variable = { global.cwec_n_passive = 1 }
		}
	}
	# Q threshold: 70.5 % of the player weights, rounded up
	set_variable = { global.cwec_q_threshold = global.cwec_w_players }
	multiply_variable = { global.cwec_q_threshold = 0.705 }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwec_q_threshold = 0.499 }
	round_variable = global.cwec_q_threshold
	# emblem: ECSC flag with one star per member (4-16), the European flag after A6
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_emblem_eu }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_emblem = 14 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { global.cwec_emblem = global.cwec_n_members }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwec_emblem = -3 }
		clamp_variable = { var = global.cwec_emblem min = 1 max = 13 }
	}
}

# Any scope. Start of the 1970 scenario (on_startup) or bootstrap of an older save.
COLDWAR_EC_initialize = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_initialized } }
		log = "[GetDateText]: COLDWAR_EC_initialize (European Communities of the Six)"
		set_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_initialized
		# the native MD European Union stays switched off in the 1970 scenario
		set_global_flag = GAME_RULE_eu_disabled
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = global.cwec_epoch } }
			set_variable = { global.cwec_epoch = global.num_days }
		}
		set_variable = { global.cwec_callrate = 0.7 }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_sh_agri = 85 }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_sh_reg = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_sh_res = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_sh_adm = 5 }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_sh_oth = 10 }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_issue = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_ticket = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_floor = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_dirty = 1 }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_name = 0 }
		# the Six, the four applicants of 1967 and the associates
		if = { limit = { country_exists = FRA } FRA = { COLDWAR_EC_join_member = yes set_variable = { cwec_member_since = 0 } } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = GER } GER = { COLDWAR_EC_join_member = yes set_variable = { cwec_member_since = 0 } } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = ITA } ITA = { COLDWAR_EC_join_member = yes set_variable = { cwec_member_since = 0 } } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = BEL } BEL = { COLDWAR_EC_join_member = yes set_variable = { cwec_member_since = 0 } } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = HOL } HOL = { COLDWAR_EC_join_member = yes set_variable = { cwec_member_since = 0 } } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = LUX } LUX = { COLDWAR_EC_join_member = yes set_variable = { cwec_member_since = 0 } } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = ENG } ENG = { set_variable = { cwec_status = 2 } set_variable = { cwec_applied = global.num_days } COLDWAR_EC_init_support = yes COLDWAR_EC_set_country_data = yes } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = IRE } IRE = { set_variable = { cwec_status = 2 } set_variable = { cwec_applied = global.num_days } COLDWAR_EC_init_support = yes COLDWAR_EC_set_country_data = yes } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = DEN } DEN = { set_variable = { cwec_status = 2 } set_variable = { cwec_applied = global.num_days } COLDWAR_EC_init_support = yes COLDWAR_EC_set_country_data = yes } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = NRY } NRY = { set_variable = { cwec_status = 2 } set_variable = { cwec_applied = global.num_days } COLDWAR_EC_init_support = yes COLDWAR_EC_set_country_data = yes } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = TUR } TUR = { COLDWAR_EC_become_associate = yes COLDWAR_EC_set_country_data = yes } }
		if = { limit = { country_exists = GRE } GRE = { COLDWAR_EC_become_associate = yes COLDWAR_EC_set_country_data = yes set_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_frozen } }
		# Council presidency: Belgium January-June 1970
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = BEL }
			set_variable = { global.cwec_pres = BEL.id }
			BEL = { add_ideas = COLDWAR_EC_presidency }
		}
		COLDWAR_EC_next_half_year = yes
		set_variable = { global.cwec_pres_next = cwec_t_next }
		# Commission: the Rey Commission until 30 June 1970, then appointment by common accord
		set_variable = { global.cwec_com = 0 }
		COLDWAR_EC_next_jul1 = yes
		set_variable = { global.cwec_com_next = cwec_t_next }
		COLDWAR_EC_next_oct1 = yes
		set_variable = { global.cwec_budget_next = cwec_t_next }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_ep_pres = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_ep_pres_next = global.num_days }
		COLDWAR_EC_recount = yes
		COLDWAR_EC_budget_recompute = yes
		COLDWAR_EC_refresh_all = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. Saves from the stage-1 build ran the Six in the native MD EU: remove its membership idea once.
COLDWAR_EC_migrate_stage1 = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_1970_mode }
		log = "[GetDateText]: COLDWAR_EC_migrate_stage1 (native MD EU of the stage-1 build removed)"
		clr_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_1970_mode
		every_country = {
			limit = { has_idea = EU_member }
			remove_ideas = EU_member
			clr_country_flag = EU_former_member
			clr_country_flag = EU_rejoin_cooldown
			if = { limit = { has_idea = foreign_data_kraken } remove_ideas = foreign_data_kraken }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Older 1970 saves start the system at the first monthly tick.
COLDWAR_EC_bootstrap = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_initialized }
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes }
		COLDWAR_EC_bootstrap_epoch = yes
		COLDWAR_EC_migrate_stage1 = yes
		COLDWAR_EC_initialize = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. Six-month presidency in the order of the national names (1 January and 1 July).
COLDWAR_EC_rotate_presidency = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_cur = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_pres > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { var:global.cwec_pres = { exists = yes } }
			var:global.cwec_pres = {
				set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_cur = cwec_rank }
				if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_EC_presidency } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_EC_presidency }
			}
		}
	}
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_best = 9999 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bestc = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_min = 9999 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_minc = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_rank > cwec_t_cur }
				check_variable = { cwec_rank < cwec_t_best } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_best = cwec_rank }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bestc = THIS.id }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_rank < cwec_t_min } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_min = cwec_rank }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_minc = THIS.id }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_bestc = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bestc = cwec_t_minc }
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwec_pres = cwec_t_bestc }
	clr_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_pres_forward_used
	clr_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_pres_free_used
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_pres > 0 } }
		var:global.cwec_pres = {
			add_ideas = COLDWAR_EC_presidency
			if = {
				limit = { is_ai = no }
				country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.10 }
			}
		}
	}
	COLDWAR_EC_next_half_year = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwec_pres_next = cwec_t_next }
}

# Any scope. temp cwec_t_term: four years, five after the Treaty on European Union.
COLDWAR_EC_commission_term = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_done_A9 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_term = 1825 }
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_term = 1460 }
	}
}

# Any scope. A new Commission term: player members nominate for 30 days, then the Council appoints by common accord.
COLDWAR_EC_open_commission = {
	COLDWAR_EC_commission_term = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwec_com_next = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwec_com_next = cwec_t_term }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_s10_phase > 0 } }
		# a nomination or vote is already running: keep it
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_EC_any_player_member = yes
			check_variable = { global.cwec_s10_phase = 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_item = 131 }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_phase = 9 }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_stage = 1 }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_target = 0 }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_by = 0 }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwec_issue = 1 }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_issue = global.cwec_issue }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_since = global.num_days }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_due = global.num_days }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwec_s10_due = 30 }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_len = 30 }
		clear_array = global.cwec_nominees
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwec_members
			if = { limit = { is_ai = no } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.11 } }
		}
	}
	else = {
		COLDWAR_EC_remove_commission_president = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. No national President of the Commission.
COLDWAR_EC_remove_commission_president = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_com > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { var:global.cwec_com = { exists = yes } }
			var:global.cwec_com = { if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_EC_commission_president } remove_ideas = COLDWAR_EC_commission_president } }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwec_com = 0 }
}

# Any scope. Appoints the nominee in the context (global.cwec_ctx_target).
COLDWAR_EC_appoint_commission = {
	COLDWAR_EC_remove_commission_president = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwec_com = global.cwec_ctx_target }
	if = {
		limit = { var:global.cwec_com = { exists = yes } }
		var:global.cwec_com = { add_ideas = COLDWAR_EC_commission_president }
	}
}

# Any scope. End of nominations: the nominee with the largest Council weight goes to the vote (earliest wins a tie).
COLDWAR_EC_close_nominations = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_best = -1 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bestc = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_nominees
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes
				COLDWAR_EC_is_member = yes
				check_variable = { cwec_weight > cwec_t_best } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_best = cwec_weight }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bestc = THIS.id }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_bestc > 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwec_s10_target = cwec_t_bestc }
		COLDWAR_EC_s10_to_queue = yes
	}
	else = {
		COLDWAR_EC_remove_commission_president = yes
		COLDWAR_EC_s10_free = yes
	}
}

# Country scope (player member). Puts forward a candidate for President of the Commission.
COLDWAR_EC_nominate = {
	add_political_power = -50
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { is_in_array = { array = global.cwec_nominees value = THIS } } }
		add_to_array = { global.cwec_nominees = THIS }
	}
}

# Any scope. After the Act on Direct Elections: first election in June, at least a year later.
COLDWAR_EC_schedule_first_election = {
	COLDWAR_EC_next_june_election = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ep_next = cwec_t_next }
	set_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_ep_scheduled
}

# Any scope. European elections every five years without end, with the direct-election seat table.
COLDWAR_EC_hold_election = {
	log = "[GetDateText]: COLDWAR_EC_hold_election"
	set_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_ep_elected
	add_to_variable = { global.cwec_ep_next = 1825 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		COLDWAR_EC_set_country_data = yes
		if = { limit = { is_ai = no } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.12 } }
	}
	COLDWAR_EC_recount = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_elect_ep_president = yes
}

# Any scope. President of the Parliament every two and a half years: the largest seated delegation.
COLDWAR_EC_elect_ep_president = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_best = -1 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bestc = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_any = -1 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_anyc = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		if = {
			limit = { is_ai = no
				check_variable = { cwec_seats > cwec_t_best } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_best = cwec_seats }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bestc = THIS.id }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_seats > cwec_t_any } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_any = cwec_seats }
			set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_anyc = THIS.id }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_bestc = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_bestc = cwec_t_anyc }
	}
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ep_pres = cwec_t_bestc }
	set_variable = { global.cwec_ep_pres_next = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwec_ep_pres_next = 912 }
}

# Country scope. temp cwec_t_z: lasting change of support for Europe (moves the target of the drift).
COLDWAR_EC_add_support = {
	add_to_variable = { cwec_support_base = cwec_t_z }
	add_to_variable = { cwec_support = cwec_t_z }
	clamp_variable = { var = cwec_support_base min = 0 max = 100 }
	clamp_variable = { var = cwec_support min = 0 max = 100 }
}

# Country scope. temp cwec_t_z: short-term change; the monthly drift brings support back to its target.
COLDWAR_EC_push_support = {
	add_to_variable = { cwec_support = cwec_t_z }
	clamp_variable = { var = cwec_support min = 0 max = 100 }
}

# Country scope. Monthly drift of 0.5 towards: starting value + lasting changes + budget + government family.
COLDWAR_EC_support_drift = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_target = cwec_support_base }
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_EC_is_member = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_big_payer }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_target = -5 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwec_net > 0 } }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_target = 5 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_government = communism }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_target = -20 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_government = nationalist has_government = fascism } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_target = -10 }
	}
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwec_t_target min = 0 max = 100 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_lo = cwec_t_target }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_lo = -0.5 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_hi = cwec_t_target }
	add_to_temp_variable = { cwec_t_hi = 0.5 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_support < cwec_t_lo } }
		add_to_variable = { cwec_support = 0.5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_support > cwec_t_hi } }
		add_to_variable = { cwec_support = -0.5 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { cwec_support = cwec_t_target }
	}
	clamp_variable = { var = cwec_support min = 0 max = 100 }
}

		add_to_variable = { cwec_q_ST = -0.02 }
		add_to_variable = { cwec_q_WE = 0.05 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_charter }
		add_to_variable = { cwec_q_ST = 0.02 }
		add_to_variable = { cwec_q_DD = 0.01 }
		add_to_variable = { cwec_q_SK = 0.06 }

	if = {

		add_to_variable = { cwec_q_ZS = 0.02 }
		add_to_variable = { cwec_q_BK = 0.02 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_ariane }
		add_to_variable = { cwec_q_BK = 0.01 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_schengen has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_snake has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_ems has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_emu has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_werner3 has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_charter has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_airbus has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_in_ariane } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_EC_participation } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_EC_participation } }
	}
	else = {
		if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_EC_participation } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_EC_participation } }
	}
	# shared assistance capacity (11.3)
	set_variable = { cwec_aidcap = global.cwec_aidcap_malus }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_aidcap < 0 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_EC_shared_aid } } } add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_EC_shared_aid } }
	}
	else = {
		if = { limit = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_EC_shared_aid } } remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = COLDWAR_EC_shared_aid } }
	}
	force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_cw_dirty
			has_country_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized }
		mdcw_cw_update_world_market = yes
		mdcw_cw_recalculate_country = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. Refreshes every member and every country with an external Community modifier.
COLDWAR_EC_refresh_all = {
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		if = { limit = { exists = yes } COLDWAR_EC_refresh_country = yes }
	}
	COLDWAR_EC_refresh_external = yes
	clr_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_cw_dirty
}

# Any scope. Recurring business without an end date: presidency, budget, Commission, elections, Parliament president.
COLDWAR_EC_calendar_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwec_pres_next } } }
		COLDWAR_EC_rotate_presidency = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwec_budget_next } } }
		COLDWAR_EC_open_budget = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwec_com_next } } }
		COLDWAR_EC_open_commission = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_ep_scheduled
			NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_done_A10 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwec_ep_next } } }
		COLDWAR_EC_hold_election = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwec_ep_pres_next } } }
		COLDWAR_EC_elect_ep_president = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. The weekly clock reads only the open files (at most ten), the running programmes and the calendar; it never loops over the world.
COLDWAR_EC_weekly = {
	COLDWAR_EC_calendar_tick = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_slots_tick = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_floor_tick = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_programmes_tick = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_recount = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_touch = yes
}

# Any scope. Monthly: support drift, budget, programme returns, modifiers, associates, Court, Commission calendar.
COLDWAR_EC_monthly = {
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_watch
		if = { limit = { exists = yes } COLDWAR_EC_support_drift = yes }
	}
	COLDWAR_EC_check_members = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_check_leavers = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_aid_recompute = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_budget_recompute = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_refresh_all = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_neighbours_month = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_court_month = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_commission_calendar = yes
	COLDWAR_EC_touch = yes
}

# Any scope. A member that no longer exists leaves the array (annexation, dissolution); its offices, loan and programmes close.
COLDWAR_EC_check_members = {
	clear_temp_array = cwec_t_dead
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { exists = yes } }
			add_to_temp_array = { cwec_t_dead = THIS }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwec_t_dead^num > 0 } }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = cwec_t_dead
			remove_from_array = { global.cwec_members = THIS }
			remove_from_array = { global.cwec_nominees = THIS }
			set_variable = { cwec_status = 0 }
		}
		# offices and accounts that pointed at a vanished member
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_pres > 0 }
				NOT = { var:global.cwec_pres = { exists = yes } } }
			COLDWAR_EC_rotate_presidency = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_com > 0 }
				NOT = { var:global.cwec_com = { exists = yes } } }
			set_variable = { global.cwec_com = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_l1_target > 0 }
				NOT = { var:global.cwec_l1_target = { exists = yes } } }
			set_variable = { global.cwec_l1_target = 0 }
			set_variable = { global.cwec_l1_weekly = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_l2_target > 0 }
				NOT = { var:global.cwec_l2_target = { exists = yes } } }
			set_variable = { global.cwec_l2_target = 0 }
			set_variable = { global.cwec_l2_weekly = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h1_target > 0 }
				check_variable = { global.cwec_h1_by > 0 }
				NOT = { var:global.cwec_h1_by = { exists = yes } } }
			COLDWAR_EC_h1_end = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h2_target > 0 }
				check_variable = { global.cwec_h2_by > 0 }
				NOT = { var:global.cwec_h2_by = { exists = yes } } }
			COLDWAR_EC_h2_end = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwec_h3_target > 0 }
				check_variable = { global.cwec_h3_by > 0 }
				NOT = { var:global.cwec_h3_by = { exists = yes } } }
			COLDWAR_EC_h3_end = yes
		}
		COLDWAR_EC_recount = yes
	}
}

# Country scope. Accession takes effect on 1 January: full member, five years of transition, the gains of the enlargement.
COLDWAR_EC_accession_effective = {
	log = "[GetDateText]: [THIS.GetName]: COLDWAR_EC accession"
	COLDWAR_EC_join_member = yes
	set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_EC_transition days = 1825 value = 1 }
	add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_EC_transition days = 1825 }
	set_global_flag = COLDWAR_EC_enlarged
	COLDWAR_EC_D1_apply = yes
	# a new Commission term starts with every enlargement
	set_variable = { global.cwec_com_next = global.num_days }
	set_temp_variable = { cwec_t_new = THIS.id }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwec_ev9_target = cwec_t_new } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_EC.9 } }
	}
	COLDWAR_EC_recount = yes
}

# Any scope. A member whose people voted to leave goes one year after the referendum.
COLDWAR_EC_check_leavers = {
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwec_members
		if = {
			limit = { exists = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_leaving
					NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < cwec_leave_on } } }
				add_to_temp_array = { cwec_t_leavers = THIS }
			}
		}
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = cwec_t_leavers
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_EC_leaving
		COLDWAR_EC_leave_member = yes
	}
}
